directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools: the narrator tools of a film
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: a film's word_onsets.py, moved byte for byte

preserve: each word's start moves to the first 10 ms window inside the word whose level is above the silence line; its end stays
with the take's line file, the script's spelling when the counts agree, a hyphen split joined into one word; otherwise whisper's spelling and a note on stderr
the old command line take words out [line] still works
allowed_deltas: one JSON request on standard input and one JSON answer as the last line
the silence line is a request field (edge_db) with the old -45 dBFS as its default
the answer counts the words that moved and says whose spelling they carry
banned_substitutions: a second word-timing engine beside audio-transcription
a silence line written into the code with no field

required_mechanisms: def main(take, words_in, out, line_json=None, edge_db=EDGE_DB)

_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. Lines holding a person's name or a private path are left out of the sources (each source names its lines), so they never reach this public repository; the first source is the byte copy.
